columns.name: ad_group_criterion_criterion_id
columns.comment: The ID of the criterion. This field is ignored for mutates.

columns.name: ad_group_id
columns.comment: The ID of the ad group.

columns.name: ad_group_base_ad_group
columns.comment: For draft or experiment ad groups, this field is the resource name of the base ad group from which this ad group was created. If a draft or experiment ad group does not have a base ad group, then this field is null. For base ad groups, this field equals the ad group resource name. This field is read-only.

columns.name: ad_group_campaign
columns.comment: The campaign to which the ad group belongs.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_bid_modifier
columns.comment: The modifier for the bid when the criterion matches. The modifier must be in the range: 0.1 - 10.0. Most targetable criteria types support modifiers.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_effective_cpc_bid_source
columns.comment: Source of the effective CPC bid.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_effective_cpm_bid_micros
columns.comment: The effective CPM (cost-per-thousand viewable impressions) bid.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_effective_cpm_bid_source
columns.comment: Source of the effective CPM bid.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_final_mobile_urls
columns.comment: The list of possible final mobile URLs after all cross-domain redirects.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_final_urls
columns.comment: The list of possible final URLs after all cross-domain redirects for the ad.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_keyword_text
columns.comment: The text of the keyword (at most 80 characters and 10 words).

columns.name: ad_group_targeting_setting_target_restrictions
columns.comment: The per-targeting-dimension setting to restrict the reach of your campaign or ad group.

columns.name: ad_group_tracking_url_template
columns.comment: The URL template for constructing a tracking URL.

columns.name: ad_group_url_custom_parameters
columns.comment: The list of mappings used to substitute custom parameter tags in a `tracking_url_template`, `final_urls`, or `mobile_final_urls`.

columns.name: campaign_base_campaign
columns.comment: The resource name of the base campaign of a draft or experiment campaign. For base campaigns, this is equal to `resource_name`. This field is read-only.

columns.name: campaign_bidding_strategy
columns.comment: Portfolio bidding strategy used by campaign.
